notes: Rounds before the current one are found only by slug: minibench (current), then minibench-YYYY-MM-DD at 14-day steps back from its start_date, stopping after 2 consecutive 404s or 40 rounds. A round off that grid would be missed.
MiniBench projects are unlisted, so /api/projects/tournaments/ does not return them.
Window = scheduled_close_time - open_time from the API. Gaps are between distinct open instants within one round (not across rounds).
First N days are counted from the round's start_date, or from its first open when a question opened before start_date.
